### Model arguments

Model arguments.

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}

::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--model`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Pretrained model in pkl format. If not provided, the model will be trained on the reference data and --reference should be provided.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"pretrained_model.pkl"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--feature_selection`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to perform feature selection.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--majority_voting`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to refine the predicted labels by running the majority voting classifier after over-clustering.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--C`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Inverse of regularization strength in logistic regression.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1.0`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_iter`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum number of iterations before reaching the minimum of the cost function.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `1000`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_SGD`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to use the stochastic gradient descent algorithm.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--min_prop`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
"For the dominant cell type within a subcluster, the minimum proportion of cells required to
support naming of the subcluster by this cell type. Ignored if majority_voting is set to False.
Subcluster that fails to pass this proportion threshold will be assigned 'Heterogeneous'."
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/celltypist/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/annotate/celltypist);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/annotate/celltypist/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
